capabilities: rephrase selected text in place from a command or inline button
cycle through alternate suggestions with the keyboard before accepting
connect to Ollama, OpenAI, OpenRouter, or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint
store provider API keys in Obsidian Secret Storage
adjust how much nearby text is sent for style and context
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The default provider is Ollama with a cloud model (nemotron-3-super:cloud), so out of the box note content is sent off-device; the README explains how to switch to a local model. Includes a detailed network and privacy section stating no telemetry, ads, or background requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get AI-generated rewording suggestions for a text selection without leaving the editor or writing to the note first.

relations.evidence: Use Ollama, OpenAI, OpenRouter, or another OpenAI-compatible chat API.
OpenAI: requests are sent to  unless you change the API base URL.
OpenRouter: requests are sent to  the plugin can also request OpenRouter's public model catalog.

summary: AI rephrasing tool that replaces selected text in the editor with suggestions from Ollama or OpenAI-compatible chat APIs.
